description: ItemsAdder item `behaviours:` / `specific_properties:` keys -> CraftEngine representation. The generator only emits target keys listed here; anything else becomes a report entry instead of being guessed.

block.note: Generates a CraftEngine block plus an item behavior block_item pointing at it.

furniture.note: Generates a CraftEngine furniture plus an item behavior furniture_item pointing at it.

elytra.note: data.equippable {slot: body}; elytra flight physics come from the material, not from a behavior.

fire_resistant.note: settings.invulnerable with the fire/lava damage sources.

throwable.note: settings.projectile exists in CraftEngine, but ItemsAdder's throwable trajectory/speed has no 1:1 field.

vehicle.note: Custom rideable vehicles are outside CraftEngine's block/item/furniture model.

backpack.note: Container GUI is an ItemsAdder runtime feature.

quiver.note: settings.allowed_projectiles covers the bow/crossbow ammo side; the storage side has no equivalent.

book.note: Static pages can move to data.written_book_content; interactive pages cannot.

liquid_bucket.note: Custom liquids are a separate ItemsAdder subsystem.

crop.note: Review: ItemsAdder crops are block variants; CraftEngine needs a crop_block behavior with an age property.

bow.note: Draw speed/arrow damage come from the vanilla bow material.

crossbow.note: Charge time comes from the vanilla crossbow material.

spear.note: CraftEngine has no thrown-spear behavior; the melee side survives as a normal item.

item.note: specific_properties.item.custom_model_data is recorded; CraftEngine assigns model ids itself unless ia_force_custom_model_data is enabled.

block.note: Legacy block definition location (same shape as behaviours.block).

potion.note: Base potion type/color survive as data.components; custom effect lists do not.

shield.note: Block cooldown comes from the vanilla shield material.

bundle.note: Bundle capacity comes from the vanilla bundle material.

fishing_rod.note: Handled by the vanilla fishing_rod material plus the item model.
